test_strip_leaked_terminal_responses: test the _strip_leaked_terminal_responses function to verify it strips terminal DSR responses from CLI input
test_plain_text_unchanged: test that plain text passes through _strip_leaked_terminal_responses without modification
test_strips_canonical_dsr_response: test that canonical DSR responses like ESC[53;1R are stripped from text input
test_strips_multiple_dsr_responses: test that multiple DSR responses scattered in text are all stripped correctly
test_does_not_strip_sgr_sequences: test that SGR color sequences are preserved and not stripped by the sanitizer
